name: Cursed
markup: When creatures with {CONDNAME_DEBUFF_CURSED} deal damage with attacks or spells, they take damage equal to 100% of their target's {STAT_attack}.

name: Mania
markup: Creatures with {CONDNAME_DEBUFF_MANIA} take damage at the end of their turn equal to 3% of the {STAT_health} all creatures had recovered when this debuff was applied.

name: Vulnerable
markup: {CONDNAME_DEBUFF_VULNERABLE} creatures take 50% more damage.

name: Savage
markup: {CONDNAME_BUFF_SAVAGE} creatures have an additional, independent chance to deal critical damage with attacks.

name: Immune
markup: Creatures with {CONDNAME_BUFF_IMMUNITY} can't be afflicted with debuffs.

name: Rebirth
markup: Creatures with {CONDNAME_BUFF_REBIRTH} are resurrected with 50% {STAT_health} when they die.

name: Berserk
markup: {CONDNAME_BUFF_BERSERK} creatures deal 50% more damage.

name: Blind
markup: {CONDNAME_DEBUFF_BLIND} creatures cannot choose their targets when {ACTION_attacking} or {ACTION_casting} single-target spells.

name: Burning
markup: Creatures with {CONDNAME_DEBUFF_BURNED} take damage based on the inflictor's {STAT_intelligence} each turn.

name: Confused
markup: {CONDNAME_DEBUFF_CONFUSED} creatures have a 50% chance to {ACTION_attack} or {ACTION_cast} harmful spells on their allies.

name: Warded
markup: Creatures with {CONDNAME_BUFF_WARD} cannot lose stats.

name: Snared
markup: Creatures with {CONDNAME_DEBUFF_SNARED} are stuck at the bottom of the Timeline until they break free. They have a 10% chance to break free at the start of each creature's turn.

name: Frozen
markup: {CONDNAME_DEBUFF_FROZEN} creatures are unable to act until they thaw, and have a 25% chance to thaw at the start of their turn. This chance doubles after each of their turns.

name: Shelled
markup: {CONDNAME_BUFF_SHELL} negates the next incoming attack or spell.

name: Invisible
markup: {CONDNAME_BUFF_INVISIBLE} creatures cannot be manually targeted by enemy attacks or spells. This buff is removed after the creature takes an action.

name: Poisoned
markup: Creatures with {CONDNAME_DEBUFF_POISON} take damage based on the inflictor's {STAT_attack} each turn.

name: Mending
markup: Creatures with {CONDNAME_BUFF_MEND} recover 30% {STAT_health} at the start of their turn.

name: Scorned
markup: Creatures with {CONDNAME_DEBUFF_SCORN} cannot attack. Overwrites {CONDNAME_DEBUFF_SILENCE}.

name: Silenced
markup: Creatures with {CONDNAME_DEBUFF_SILENCE} cannot cast spells. Overwrites {CONDNAME_DEBUFF_SCORN}.

name: Sleeping
markup: Creatures with {CONDNAME_DEBUFF_SLEEP} cannot act until they either take damage or this debuff wears off.

name: Stone
markup: Creatures with {CONDNAME_DEBUFF_STONE} cannot dodge or deal critical damage.

name: Leeching
markup: Creatures with {CONDNAME_BUFF_LEECH} recover {STAT_health} equal to 25% of the damage they deal.

name: Agile
markup: Creatures with {CONDNAME_BUFF_AGILE} have an additional, independent chance to dodge attacks.

name: Weak
markup: {CONDNAME_DEBUFF_WEAK} creatures deal 50% less damage.

name: Bleeding
markup: Creatures with {CONDNAME_DEBUFF_BLEED} take damage equal to 30% of their Current {STAT_health} at the start of each turn.

name: Blighted
markup: Creatures with {CONDNAME_DEBUFF_BLIGHT} cannot be healed and take damage from healing effects equal to 50% of the effect.

name: Taunting
markup: Creatures with {CONDNAME_BUFF_TAUNT} automatically {ACTION_provoke} at the end of their turn.

name: Defensive
markup: Creatures with {CONDNAME_BUFF_DEFENSIVE} automatically {ACTION_defend} at the end of their turn.

name: Protected
markup: Creatures with {CONDNAME_BUFF_PROTECT} take 50% less damage.

name: Splashing
markup: Creatures with {CONDNAME_BUFF_SPLASH} deal 50% of their damage to enemies adjacent to the target they {ACTION_attack}.

name: Barrier
markup: {CONDNAME_BUFF_BARRIER} absorbs a certain amount of damage. After the maximum amount of damage is dealt, the buff is removed. {CONDNAME_BUFF_BARRIER} strength cannot exceed 200% of a creature's highest stat when this buff is applied.

name: Arcane
markup: When an {CONDNAME_BUFF_ARCANE} creature {ACTION_casts} a spell, the spell does not consume any {STAT_charges}. Then, this buff is removed.

name: Feared
markup: {CONDNAME_DEBUFF_FEAR} creatures cannot gain stats.

name: Disarmed
markup: {CONDNAME_DEBUFF_DISARMED} creatures lose the benefits from their equipped Artifact, other than {STAT_health}.

name: Inverted
markup: {CONDNAME_DEBUFF_INVERTED} creatures heal enemies instead of damaging them with attacks and spells, and damage allies instead of healing them. This debuff is removed after enough damage or healing has been done to offset its potency.

name: Repelling
markup: {CONDNAME_BUFF_REPELLING} creatures have a 50% chance to ignore damage from spells.

name: Proficient
markup: {CONDNAME_BUFF_PROFICIENT} creatures gain 30% more benefits from their Artifact's Stat Slots.

name: Bomb
markup: At the start of a creature's turn, its {CONDNAME_DEBUFF_BOMB} detonates, dealing damage to the creature equal to 80% of the afflictor's {STAT_speed}. Then, this debuff is removed.

name: Animated Gem
markup: After the {CONDNAME_MINION_ANIMATEDGEM}'s master manually {ACTION_casts} a spell, this minion {ACTION_casts} one of its master's Spell Gems as well, chosen randomly.

name: Animated Weapon
markup: When the {CONDNAME_MINION_ANIMATEDWEAPON}'s master {ACTION_attacks}, it deals additional damage equal to the highest total stat from all of its Artifact's Stat Slots.

name: Conquest
markup: After {CONDNAME_MINION_CONQUEST}'s master manually {ACTION_casts} a spell, it grants all your creatures a random buff.

name: Death
markup: At the start of {CONDNAME_MINION_DEATH}'s master's turn, it has a chance to kill the enemy with the lowest {STAT_health}. The chance is increased based on how low the enemy's {STAT_health} is.

name: Famine
markup: After {CONDNAME_MINION_FAMINE}'s master {ACTION_attacks}, it decreases the target's Maximum {STAT_health} by an amount equal to 30% of the damage dealt.

name: War
markup: After {CONDNAME_MINION_WAR}'s master is damaged, it deals damage to the enemy equal to 50% of the damage taken.

name: Guardian of Surathli
markup: After the {CONDNAME_MINION_GUARDIANOFSURATHLI}'s master is killed, it is resurrected with 100% {STAT_health} and receives a {CONDNAME_BUFF_BARRIER} that absorbs damage equal to 100% of its Health. Then, this minion disappears.

name: Illusion
markup: This {CONDNAME_MINION_ILLUSION}'s master's post-action effects (on-attack, on-cast, and so on) activate 2 additional times.

name: Torun Junior
markup: {CONDNAME_MINION_LITTLETORUN} SHOOTS LASERS AND !@#$.

name: Unstable Horror
markup: This minion's master has 5% more stats for each {CONDNAME_MINION_UNSTABLEHORROR} it has. After this minion's master {ACTION_defends} or {ACTION_provokes}, it deals damage to all enemies equal to 10% of its master's highest stat for each stack of {CONDNAME_MINION_UNSTABLEHORROR} it has. Maximum of 9 stacks.

name: Spiderlings
markup: After this minion's master takes damage from an enemy, each of its {CONDNAME_MINION_SPIDERLING} explode, dealing damage to the enemy equal to 50% of the master's Current {STAT_health}. Maximum of 9 stacks.

name: Writhelings
markup: After this minion's master takes damage from an attack or spell, each {CONDNAME_MINION_WRITHELING} afflicts a random enemy with a random debuff. Maximum of 5 stacks.

name: Zombies
markup: At the start of this minion's master's turn, each {CONDNAME_MINION_ZOMBIE} deals damage to a random enemy equal to 50% of its {STAT_attack}. Maximum of 9 stacks.

name: Dire Wolves
markup: After this minion's master attacks, each {CONDNAME_MINION_DIREWOLF} deals damage to the target equal to 30% of its {STAT_speed}. Maximum of 5 stacks.

name: Doppelganger
markup: The {CONDNAME_MINION_DOPPELGANGER}'s master has a 25% chance to take an extra turn.

name: Amalgamation
markup: After the {CONDNAME_MINION_AMALGAMATION}'s master deals damage with an attack or spell, this minion deals damage to a random enemy equal to 5% of its master's highest stat multiplied by the number of minions it has.

name: Microbots
markup: At the end of this minion's master's turn, each {CONDNAME_MINION_MICROBOT} deals damage to a random enemy equal to 50% of its {STAT_intelligence}. Maximum of 9 stacks.

name: Mammon
markup: When {CONDNAME_MINION_MAMMON}'s master takes damage, the damage is reduced by 2% for each stack of each Lesser Demon it has. This minion is a Greater Demon.

name: Leviathan
markup: When {CONDNAME_MINION_LEVIATHAN}'s master kills an enemy, it gains 5 stacks of each Lesser Demon. This minion is a Greater Demon.

name: Beelzebub
markup: When {CONDNAME_MINION_BEELZEBUB}'s master kills an enemy, it gains a random Greater Demon. This minion is a Greater Demon.

name: Belphegor
markup: When {CONDNAME_MINION_BELPHEGOR}'s master {ACTION_casts} a single-target spell, it targets all the creatures fighting on the target's side. This minion is a Greater Demon.

name: Asmodeus
markup: When {CONDNAME_MINION_ASMODEUS}' master {ACTION_attacks}, it always deals critical damage, cannot be dodged, and damages all other enemies for 50% less damage. This minion is a Greater Demon.

name: Satanachia
markup: At the end of {CONDNAME_MINION_SATANACHIA}'s master's turn, it {ACTION_casts} the last 3 spells creatures {ACTION_cast} in the current battle. This minion is a Greater Demon.

name: Lucifer
markup: At the start of {CONDNAME_MINION_LUCIFER}'s master's turn, it {ACTION_attacks} random enemies 3 times. This minion is a Greater Demon.

name: Brim Fiends
markup: When this minion's master {ACTION_attacks}, it sacrifices each {CONDNAME_MINION_BRIMFIEND} to increase its damage by 50% per stack. Maximum of 9 stacks. This minion is a Lesser Demon.

name: Fire Imps
markup: When this minion's master {ACTION_casts} a spell, it sacrifices each {CONDNAME_MINION_FIREIMP} to increase its potency by 30% per stack. Maximum of 9 stacks. This minion is a Lesser Demon.

name: Chaos Satyrs
markup: After this minion's master {ACTION_defends} or {ACTION_provokes}, it sacrifices each {CONDNAME_MINION_CHAOSSATYR} to deal damage to enemies equal to 15% of its highest stat per stack. Maximum of 9 stacks. This minion is a Lesser Demon.
